items.t: Engine stalls with a "steering power low" message
items.job: Diagnose stalling (codes, battery, fuel and sensor checks)
items.note: Should be covered under warranty on most cars.

items.t: Sudden loss of power or hybrid system warning
items.note: Covered by Toyota's hybrid warranty on most cars.

items.t: 12-volt battery dies or charging system warning
items.job: Replace 12V battery and test charging system

items.t: "Engine Maintenance Required" from a failed coolant bypass valve
items.note: Ask a dealer whether Toyota coverage applies to your VIN.

items.t: Milky oil and low oil pressure warning in cold weather
items.job: Oil and filter change per Toyota bulletin
items.note: Should be covered under warranty when the bulletin applies.

items.t: Passenger airbag may not deploy correctly (recall)
Driver airbag may be disabled by a weak steering wire weld (recall)
Brake assist may drop out while turning (recall)
Pedestrian warning sound too quiet in reverse (recall)

items.note: May be covered under warranty or insurance glass coverage.

items.t: Brakes apply unexpectedly or collision warnings with nothing ahead
items.job: Inspect and recalibrate front camera and radar
items.note: Free under warranty on most cars.

items.t: Power steering assist cuts out briefly
items.note: Covered under warranty on these newer cars.
Replacing the CVT, if needed, costs several thousand dollars but is covered by the powertrain warranty.

items.t: Shadows from the headlights at night
Dim or hard-to-see tail and brake lights
items.job: Replace a faulty rear lamp assembly
items.note: No repair if all segments light up.

items.job: Replace key fob battery or diagnose smart key system
items.note: A new fob battery costs a few dollars; a new programmed fob costs more.

items.t: Screen pop-ups and repeated PIN prompts
Power liftgate stops opening after a software update
items.note: Should be free when caused by a recall update.
